paper.title: Fermi Sets: Universal and interpretable neural architectures for fermions

results.system_description: Static BCC hydrogen, N = 16, r_s = 1.31 bohr, 2x2x2 BCC supercell, PBC, Born-Oppenheimer, proton-proton Ewald energy
results.variant: K = 8 determinants, 238,024 parameters; one model trained on four geometries
results.source_location: Supplementary Material, Table "Variational energy per atom for BCC solid hydrogen", Equilibrium BCC
results.eligibility_evidence: Variational energy per atom of the Fermi Sets wave function at the equilibrium BCC geometry, evaluated from 21,000 independent Monte Carlo blocks.
results.notes: Energy per atom, Hartree. The hydrogen benchmark appears only in v2. A single set of parameters was trained on the equilibrium geometry and three randomly displaced ones; only the equilibrium geometry is a Ketboard instance (the displaced geometries list displacement vectors per atom index, but not the site of each index beyond corners 0-7 and body centres 8-15). The text gives the statistical errors as about 0.1 mHa/atom; the table prints (1) in the fifth decimal, recorded here.
